senses.definition: The named place London in the supplied 1599 publication imprint.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of passion
lexicon.label: passionate_affect

senses.definition: Moved by strong emotion, the title of The Passionate Pilgrim; native passion-family adjective, not a phonetic rendering of a common English word.

citations.locator: Authored native lexical derivation: ink + press

lexicon.etymology: Authored native lexical derivation: ink + press
lexicon.label: print_text

senses.definition: Produce writing by an inked impression, the appendix’s first printed versions. Native ink-press; no particular press mechanism is invented.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of caesar
lexicon.label: caesar_octavian

senses.definition: Octavius Caesar in Antony and Cleopatra, not Julius Caesar or an unspecified imperial title. The printed name remains Caesar; the distinguishing identity is not appended to its construction gloss.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of devoted
lexicon.label: devotion_attention

senses.definition: Absorbed commitment of the eyes in Philo’s office-and-devotion image; nominal use of native devoted, without importing an irrevocable Biblical dedication.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of temperance
lexicon.label: temper_restraint

senses.definition: Self-command, firmness and measured disposition renounced by Antony’s heart in Philo’s accusation. Not bodily temperature; the martial metal-temper resonance is documented separately.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_dung
lexicon.label: dung_material

senses.definition: Excrement enriching the common earth in Antony’s dungy-earth image; no inherited sacrificial disposal rule or Biblical participants.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_ambassador
lexicon.label: ambassador_envoy

senses.definition: A commissioned representative or envoy, the messengers Cleopatra urges Antony to hear. No inherited deceptive-visit claim is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of punish
lexicon.label: punishment_penalty

senses.definition: The penalty threatened rhetorically by Antony if the world denies the lovers’ peerlessness; nominal penalty, without an added particular punishment.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of false
lexicon.label: falsehood_utterance

senses.definition: An untrue utterance, Cleopatra’s teasing judgment of Antony’s extravagant assertion; nominal false, not an independently established narrator verdict.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: equal + without
lexicon.label: peerless_equal

senses.definition: Having no equal, the lovers’ claimed supremacy. Not literally having no companions or noble peers.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: cleopatra

senses.definition: Cleopatra, queen of Egypt and Antony’s lover in the play.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_soothsayer
lexicon.label: soothsayer_role

senses.definition: The unnamed diviner in Cleopatra’s household. Keeps the inherited native divination-person role without importing Daniel’s court or certifying the predictions.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_witch
lexicon.label: witch_role

senses.definition: A witch as the teasing or accusing role assigned by Charmian to the soothsayer. No imported Biblical prohibition or assertion that magic works.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: before + see
lexicon.label: foresee_future

senses.definition: See what will come, contrasted by the soothsayer with making a fortune happen.

lexicon.label: inch_measure

senses.definition: An inch, one twelfth of the source foot, expressed as an exact Unta spoken fraction plus foot. The fortune/body joke retains the measure; no modern millimetre standard is imposed on the early source.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of idle
lexicon.label: idleness_inactivity

senses.definition: Antony’s inactivity or neglect of affairs, which he says hatches harms. Distinct from the plant love-in-idleness.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of turn
lexicon.label: revolution_turning

senses.definition: A turning or change of condition that lowers present pleasure into its opposite; not a modern political revolution or a specified number of rotations.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: fitting + manner
lexicon.label: fitting_order

senses.definition: Fitting correspondence or proper order, Iras’s sarcastic demand that Isis match an ugly rogue with cuckoldry.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_member_body_romans
lexicon.label: bodily_member

senses.definition: A bodily member, the generative members in Enobarbus’s tailor metaphor. The source may also evoke persons who make replacement clothing; the target retains the bodily image without listing organs or importing Paul’s moral argument.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: inside + garment
lexicon.label: undergarment_smock

senses.definition: A woman’s shift or undergarment, the old smock in Enobarbus’s wife-as-clothing metaphor. Distinct from the lower petticoat.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: below + garment
lexicon.label: underskirt_petticoat

senses.definition: A lower or under-skirt garment, the new petticoat replacing an old smock in the metaphor. No modern fabric or precise cut is imposed.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of mud
lexicon.label: slime_river_mud

senses.definition: The moist river mud of the Nile in the oath about life arising from it; not Biblical earth-pitch sealant.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: victory + leaf
lexicon.label: laurel_leaf

senses.definition: The laurel leaf/crown convention associated with victory in Cleopatra’s farewell. Native victory-leaf retains that emblem without claiming every victory leaf is the same botanical species.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_multitude
lexicon.label: multitude_people

senses.definition: The threatening numbers of people alienated from the current state in Antony’s account. A numerous mass without an asserted exact count; no Biblical crowd or ritual context is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of summary
lexicon.label: abstract_summary

senses.definition: A concentrated summary or embodiment of faults in Caesar’s accusation, not a scholarly abstract or an abstract quality opposed to the concrete.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of trifle
lexicon.label: lightness_frivolity

senses.definition: Frivolity whose cost is a heavy weight on Antony’s partners. The light/heavy metaphor is retained in the source review.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of dry
lexicon.label: dryness_condition

senses.definition: The dry wasting of bones invoked as a consequence of excess, not a new medical diagnosis or advice.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_urine
lexicon.label: urine_liquid

senses.definition: Horse urine reportedly drunk during Antony’s military hardship. The bodily liquid is kept distinct from stale food or an added siege context.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: grass + field
lexicon.label: pasture_grazing

senses.definition: Grazing ground covered with snow in the deer comparison, native grass-field.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of face
lexicon.label: face_confront

senses.definition: Face or confront the present emergency with available land and sea forces, source front. Native nominal face converted to a verb; no specified battle opponent is inserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: he + adjroot
lexicon.label: male_sex

senses.definition: Explicit male modifier when the source distinguishes a stag from deer generally. Native masculine-pronoun plus adjectival root, parallel to inherited female zanna; not an extra human participant.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_morsel
lexicon.label: morsel_food

senses.definition: A small food portion, Cleopatra’s self-image as a morsel for a monarch; not an exact measure or a whole meal.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of caesar
lexicon.label: caesar_julius

senses.definition: Julius Caesar, Cleopatra’s remembered lover who is now dead. Distinct from Octavius Caesar in the current political scenes; no identity suffix is printed as a name.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of force
lexicon.label: violence_intensity

senses.definition: The force or intensity of Antony’s sadness or mirth, which Cleopatra finds becoming; not an added act of physical assault.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: pearl + shell
lexicon.label: oyster_shellfish

senses.definition: The pearl-bearing shellfish of Antony’s gift metaphor. Native pearl-shell cultural designation; no claim that every oyster yields a pearl or that the poem identifies a modern species.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: atlas_figure

senses.definition: Atlas, the world-bearing figure in Cleopatra’s demi-Atlas comparison; a personal mythic name, not a map collection.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: phoebus_sun

senses.definition: Phoebus, the personified sun whose amorous pinches darken Cleopatra in her speech. The named allusion remains rather than replacing it with an unnamed weather process.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of benefit
lexicon.label: profit_advantage

senses.definition: Benefit found through refusal of harmful prayers; no compulsory monetary return or new amount.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_reconcile_relation
lexicon.label: reconcile_people

senses.definition: Bring estranged people into agreement, source atone in Maecenas’s mediation. Distinct from ritual expiation; no sacrificial doctrine or unprinted agent is introduced.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: fire + seed
lexicon.label: ember_fireseed

senses.definition: A small glowing remnant that can rekindle fire; native fire-seed, used for the quarrel Lepidus asks Enobarbus not to stir. No literal botanical seed is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: anger + keep
lexicon.label: stomaching_resentment

senses.definition: Keeping private bitter anger, source stomaching. This is resentment rather than the digestive organ or swallowing food.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: jupiter_jove

senses.definition: Jupiter, the source name for the same Roman god also called Jove. Retain the variant rather than treating it as a planet in Enobarbus’s oath.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of ring
lexicon.label: hoop_binding

senses.definition: A circular binding band holding the rulers firm together in Caesar’s image. Not a numerically specified ring size or a newly implied marriage ceremony.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of pipe
lexicon.label: flute_instrument

senses.definition: A hollow breath-played musical pipe setting the oars’ rhythm. Distinct from Francis Flute in Midsummer; no modern instrument design is imposed.

citations.locator: Authored native derivation: water + beat + instrument

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: water + beat + instrument
lexicon.label: oar_implement

senses.definition: A hand-worked implement beating water to propel a vessel. Native water-beat-instrument; not row meaning an arrangement of items.

citations.locator: Authored native derivation: ship + shore + floor

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: ship + shore + floor
lexicon.label: wharf_landing

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: many + form
lexicon.label: variety_forms

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: morning + meal
lexicon.label: breakfast_meal

senses.definition: The morning meal where eight whole boars and twelve guests are reported. No invented meal time or Unta calendar unit.

lexicon.label: invite_guest

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of perfume_scent
lexicon.label: perfume_apply

senses.definition: Imbue with a pleasing scent, the barge’s perfumed sails. Native scent converted to an action; no formula, ingredient or Biblical ritual is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_rudder_acts
lexicon.label: helm_steering

senses.definition: The steering apparatus or station of Cleopatra’s barge, native ship-turn. Distinct from a warrior’s helmet; no modern wheel or particular rudder arrangement is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_rudder_acts
lexicon.label: steer_course

senses.definition: Direct a vessel’s course, native ship-turn used as an action. The attendant steers; no Acts voyage or shipwreck is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: measure + straight
lexicon.label: square_measure

senses.definition: An angled measuring square used figuratively for correct conduct, paired with the measuring rule. Not a quarrel, a plaza, an arithmetic power, or an inserted numerical angle.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: chance + token
lexicon.label: lot_token

senses.definition: A token drawn to decide by chance. Distinct from a landed allotment, the personal name Lot, and an unspecified large amount.

senses.definition: Adult male domestic fowl, the fighting cock in Antony’s comparison. A deliberate lexical counterpart to native hen kekla; the ending is not a productive sex-changing suffix.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of furies
lexicon.label: fury_avenger

senses.definition: One of the named mythic Furies, imagined with snakes around her head. Distinct from ordinary anger; the individual belongs to the named collective, not a new woman surnamed Fury.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: fish_creature + wing
lexicon.label: fish_fin

senses.definition: A fish’s projecting swimming organ, fish-wing by analogy. No claim that it flies or a distinct fish species is supplied.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: wet + smooth
lexicon.label: slimy_surface

senses.definition: Wet slippery coating on a surface, here fish jaws. Distinct from river mud and the historical earth-pitch sense of slime.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: chance + give
lexicon.label: wager_stake

senses.definition: Commit a stake to the outcome of a contest, native chance-give. No monetary amount, equal stake or new rule is implied.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: prison + guard
lexicon.label: jailer_role

senses.definition: The keeper bringing a prisoner out, used for the phrase But yet. Native prison-guard; not a host offering lodgings.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: rule + land
lexicon.label: province_region

senses.definition: An administratively ruled territory that Cleopatra offers as a reward. Native rule-land, no fabricated area or map boundary.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: lightning + strike
lexicon.label: thunderbolt_strike

senses.definition: A destructive lightning stroke in Cleopatra’s claim that even innocents may be hit. Native lightning-strike, not a crossbow bolt or merely the sound of thunder.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: nile_river

senses.definition: The source Nile variant for the same river elsewhere called Nilus. Distinct display form, shared geographic referent; no invented tributary.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_ordinal_j_over_b

senses.definition: Exact ordinal quantity 9; Unta 9.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of benefit
lexicon.label: boot_compensate

senses.definition: Benefit or compensate the messenger with an additional gift, source boot. Distinct from footwear and from the kicking threat in the earlier speech.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: soak + heat
lexicon.label: stew_simmer

senses.definition: Heat while immersed in liquid, Cleopatra’s cruel imagined brine punishment. A native soak-heat action, not a claim of a performed event or a technical preparation procedure.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of contract
lexicon.label: treaty_agreement

senses.definition: The negotiated political compact to be written and sealed among the rulers. Distinct from writing a literary composition or an unmentioned marriage agreement.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: bed + cushion
lexicon.label: mattress_bed

senses.definition: A padded bedding support in which the queen is reportedly carried. Native bed-cushion; preserve the supplied mattress rather than substituting a carpet from another telling.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of behaviour
lexicon.label: conduct_life

senses.definition: Conversation in its manner-of-living sense, Octavia’s holy, cold and still disposition. Not merely how she talks in a conversation.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of entreat
lexicon.label: entreaty_request

senses.definition: An earnest appeal, Lepidus’s request that the others stop provoking one another. Nominal use of the native entreat root, not an already granted command.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of bodily_member
lexicon.label: body_organ

senses.definition: An acting part of the body in Antony’s deliberately uninformative crocodile description. Not a musical instrument, organization or exclusively generative organ.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: river + kjv_lizard
lexicon.label: crocodile_creature

senses.definition: The large river reptile named in the Egyptian drinking conversation. Native river-lizard is a lexicalized creature name, not a claim about modern taxonomy or a respelling of the English/Greek word.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_wine_vat
lexicon.label: wine_vat

senses.definition: A wine-holding vat in the song’s wish to drown cares. Native wine-container, no Biblical winepress judgment or fixed capacity is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of chorus
lexicon.label: chorus_refrain

senses.definition: The holding or recurring sung response assigned to all the men after the boy’s verse. Not a bodily grip, holding office or a new cast member named Chorus.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: bacchus_god

senses.definition: The wine god addressed by name in the banquet song. A permitted personal divine name, not a loan replacing the native word for wine or revelry.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: arrow + shoot
lexicon.label: arrow_shooting

senses.definition: The darting epithet of Parthia in Ventidius’s address, here projectile-shooting. Native arrow-shoot preserves the weapon image rather than rapid bodily darting.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_scribe
lexicon.label: scribe_writer

senses.definition: A trained writer in Enobarbus’s list of people and expressive powers. Native write-person, without importing the separate religious-law role.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: verse + sing
lexicon.label: bard_singer

senses.definition: A singer of poetry in the list of those unable to express Lepidus’s love. Native verse-sing-agent, distinct from the following general composer noun poet.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: soft + feather
lexicon.label: down_feather

senses.definition: Fine soft bird down, the feather poised on the tide. Native soft-feather distinguishes the material from downward direction.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: hold + fight
lexicon.label: wrestle_grapple

senses.definition: Grapple by bodily holds, Antony’s loving wrestling embrace of Caesar. Native hold-fight preserves the martial affection metaphor without adding an actual hostile contest.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of doubt
lexicon.label: distrust_person

senses.definition: Doubt in another person’s promised conduct, Antony’s response to Caesar’s warning. Native doubt used as an interpersonal noun; not a numerical uncertainty estimate or a proven accusation of betrayal.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_cardinal_da_over_b

senses.definition: Exact cardinal quantity 30; Unta 26.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of split
lexicon.label: rift_gap

senses.definition: The opening produced when the world cleaves in Octavia’s imagined civil war. Nominal native split, not an unrelated named geographic feature.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of confine
lexicon.label: confinement_prison

senses.definition: The prison bounds imposed on Lepidus and imagined released only by death. Native confine used as a place/state noun; not a precise cell dimension.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_grind
lexicon.label: grind_crush

senses.definition: Crush by rubbing or pressure, here the paired jaws grinding one another. Native grind retained without implying an actual grain mill or merely sharpening an edge.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_retinue
lexicon.label: retinue_attendants

senses.definition: Octavia’s accompanying train of attendants. Native follow-company, not a railway, an army she does not have, or a particular Biblical court.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_minister
lexicon.label: minister_agent

senses.definition: An assisting agent, Caesar’s claim that the gods make him and Octavia’s friends their ministers of justice. No clerical or modern cabinet office, and the claim remains his rhetoric.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_cyprus_acts
lexicon.label: cyprus_island

senses.definition: Cyprus in Caesar’s report of Cleopatra’s awarded territories. Same allowed place form, without importing Barnabas or modern borders.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: part + give
lexicon.label: apportion_allot

senses.definition: Assign a portion or territory to a recipient. Native part-give, distinguishing allocation from a price rating or an unqualified physical handover.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of throne
lexicon.label: enthrone_rule

senses.definition: Install or display someone as a ruler upon a ceremonial seat, in Caesar’s account of Antony and Cleopatra. Native throne made verbal, without adding another physical throne above their golden chairs.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_legion
lexicon.label: legion_military

senses.definition: A Roman military grouping unit in Antony’s land forces. Native army-group; nineteen legions is preserved without assuming an unstated fixed number of soldiers per legion or importing the Biblical spirit-name Legion.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_slack
lexicon.label: slack_effort

senses.definition: Lax in effort or readiness, Antony’s response to the rebuke about speed. Not a slack rope or a literal absence of muscle strength.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: land + head
lexicon.label: headland_cape

senses.definition: The projecting land at Actium from which Antony proposes a sea attack. Native land-head; no new coordinates or an asserted cliff height.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_cardinal_bj_over_b

senses.definition: Exact cardinal quantity 19; Unta 17.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: wood + flat
lexicon.label: plank_board

senses.definition: A flat length of timber used in a ship, the veteran’s rotten-planks warning. Native wood-flat; the adjective rotten remains his accusation rather than an inspection finding.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_rudder_acts
lexicon.label: rudder_ship

senses.definition: The ship steering member turned in the withdrawal from Actium. Native ship-turn; no particular modern rudder construction or Acts voyage is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: soldier + part
lexicon.label: squadron_detachment

senses.definition: A body or subdivision of soldiers in the proposed hill position; not an aircraft unit or an invented fixed troop count.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: water + bird
lexicon.label: waterfowl_native

senses.definition: A water bird, used with explicit wild and male modifiers for Scarus’s mallard image. Native water-bird avoids an unnecessary foreign bird-name sound.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_cardinal_g_over_b

senses.definition: Exact cardinal quantity 6; Unta 6.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_cow
lexicon.label: cow_bovine

senses.definition: Adult female bovine in the gadfly simile; native existing bovine name, without importing Biblical livestock contexts.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: empire + queen
lexicon.label: empress_sovereign

senses.definition: Imperial female ruler as Iras’s honorific address to Cleopatra. Native dominion-queen, not a phonetic ordinary title or an assertion of a new formal office.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of protect
lexicon.label: protection_shelter

senses.definition: Sheltering protection, the shroud Caesar’s envoy offers Cleopatra. Native keep-safe used as an action noun; not the burial cloth sense.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: water + enter
lexicon.label: leak_vessel

senses.definition: Admit water through an unsound vessel, Antony’s leaking-ship image in Enobarbus’s aside. Native water-enter used of the vessel, not a modern disclosure of secret information.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_filth
lexicon.label: filth_dirt

senses.definition: Defiling dirt into which Antony imagines judgment dropped; physical filth with moral metaphor, not a new medical claim.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_lace_cord
lexicon.label: clothing_lace

senses.definition: The fastening laces of clothing, source points tied by Caesar’s attendant; no number or pointing gesture.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: proud + walk
lexicon.label: strut_walk

senses.definition: Walk in ostentatious pride, the movement toward ruin in Antony’s accusation.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: kjv_cord + ring
lexicon.label: noose_rope

senses.definition: A rope loop around the condemned neck in the hanging comparison.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: hang
lexicon.label: hangman_executioner

senses.definition: The executor of a hanging, not a person who merely hangs clothes.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: deep + pit
lexicon.label: abyss_chasm

senses.definition: The deep chasm in the imagined fall of guiding stars into hell.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: beak + strike
lexicon.label: peck_bird

senses.definition: Strike with a bird’s beak; distinct from peck as a source dry measure.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of loss
lexicon.label: diminution_loss

senses.definition: A decrease in rational capacity in Enobarbus’s judgment of Antony; not complete loss of the brain.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: anger + full
lexicon.label: furious_anger

senses.definition: Passion-filled fury that overrides fear in Enobarbus’s paradox; not a clinical diagnosis.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_ordinal_e_over_b

senses.definition: Exact ordinal quantity 4; Unta 4.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_bounty
lexicon.label: bounty_generosity

senses.definition: Generous giving beyond what is owed, Antony’s gift to the deserter. No bounty for capture is intended.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_roller_bandage
lexicon.label: bandage_cloth

senses.definition: Cloth bound about a wound, the clouts Scarus imagines around the routed soldiers’ heads. Not blows or discarded rags in this occurrence.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: name + mark
lexicon.label: sign_signature

senses.definition: Place a personal identifying mark on a written message to endorse it; subscribe in Antony’s letter instruction, not enroll in a service.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_mineral_vein
lexicon.label: mine_resource

senses.definition: A worked mineral source, used of Antony as an inexhaustible store of generosity. The native metal-path image preserves extraction and abundance, distinct from possessive mine.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_unload
lexicon.label: unload_cargo

senses.definition: Remove carried goods from the messenger’s mules; a later contextual use of native carry-out without an imported historical narrative.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of hard
lexicon.label: hardness_resistance

senses.definition: Resistance to breaking or yielding, the flinty hardness of Enobarbus’s fault in his self-accusation. Abstract nominal use, not a named material.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of record
lexicon.label: record_register

senses.definition: A written record in which the world may class Enobarbus; the action record used nominally, not a new bureaucratic office.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of score
lexicon.label: contest_goal

senses.definition: A success scored in a contest, Antony’s goal-for-goal comparison with youth. Native tally sense; not an explicit quantity of twenty or a modern sporting rule.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_fingernail
lexicon.label: fingernail_body

senses.definition: Octavia’s prepared nails in Antony’s threatened humiliation of Cleopatra; bodily nails, not fastening spikes.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: play + leaf
lexicon.label: playing_card

senses.definition: A marked playing leaf in the metaphor of secretly arranged cards; not a greeting card or a written letter.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal or place name.
lexicon.label: alcides_hercules

senses.definition: The source name for Hercules whom Antony invokes as his ancestor; same mythic figure, not a second unrelated god.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: signal + call
lexicon.label: beckon_gesture

senses.definition: Call or summon by a sign; Cleopatra’s eye beckoning armies, not necessarily a spoken order.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: body + garment
lexicon.label: shirt_tunic

senses.definition: The body garment in the Nessus allusion, a tunic or shirt rather than a modern buttoned design. Native body-garment.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: wood + strike
lexicon.label: club_weapon

senses.definition: The heavy striking weapon of Hercules; wooden striker, distinct from a social club.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_dart
lexicon.label: dart_weapon

senses.definition: A pointed missile weapon, the Parthian darts which failed to kill Antony; not a modern sport or an assumed arrow mechanism.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of terror
lexicon.label: horror_dread

senses.definition: Overwhelming dread in the anticipated pursuit of humiliation; no supernatural apparition is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_bridegroom
lexicon.label: bridegroom_marriage

senses.definition: A man entering marriage, Antony’s image of running to death like a lover’s bed. No inherited solar simile or unseen wedding ceremony is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of medicine
lexicon.label: drug_preparation

senses.definition: An active preparation taken for its bodily effect. Cleopatra means drugs capable of causing death alongside knives and serpents; this later contextual extension of the native medicinal-preparation word does not imply that the preparation is healing or harmless.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: house + task
lexicon.label: household_chore

senses.definition: An ordinary household task, the meanest chares in Cleopatra’s speech; no invented list of duties.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of sound
lexicon.label: crack_breaking_sound

senses.definition: The loud report of a great thing breaking in Caesar’s reaction to Antony’s death. A contextual audible crash, distinct from a narrow physical chink.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of fault
lexicon.label: taint_fault

senses.definition: A fault or blemish of character weighed against Antony’s honours. Native fault, not the verb infect another person.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of desolate
lexicon.label: desolation_abandonment

senses.definition: Cleopatra’s condition of being emptied and abandoned after Antony’s death. Nominal extension of native desolate, not a newly depopulated geographic territory.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of favour
lexicon.label: kindness_benevolence

senses.definition: Benevolent disposition expressed in gracious treatment, Proculeius’s assurance about Caesar. Native favour extended to kindness; not native kind meaning species.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of state
lexicon.label: plight_distress

senses.definition: A distressed condition, Cleopatra’s plight that Proculeius says its author pities. Native condition in an explicitly adverse context.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of matter
lexicon.label: element_medium

senses.definition: The elemental medium in which a being lives, water in the dolphin comparison. Contextual matter/substance, not a modern chemical element or an unspecified habitat.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: silver + money
lexicon.label: silver_coin

senses.definition: A silver coin, the plate falling from Antony’s pocket in Cleopatra’s extravagant comparison. No exact denomination, weight, or number is specified.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_ditch
lexicon.label: ditch_ground

senses.definition: A ditch in the ground imagined as Cleopatra’s gentler grave. Reuses the native ground-cut noun; no new depth, location within Egypt, or digging action is added.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_sew
lexicon.label: sew_stitch

senses.definition: Join or close by stitching; Seleucus would sew his lips shut rather than lie at his peril. The source seeling/falconry resonance is noted in the verse review, without replacing lips with eyelids.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of ungrateful
lexicon.label: ingratitude_failure

senses.definition: Failure to return gratitude, Cleopatra’s charge against Seleucus. Nominal use of the inherited native ungrateful form.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_apron
lexicon.label: apron_front_cover

senses.definition: A body-front protective covering worn by the workmen Cleopatra imagines. Reuses the native apron noun without retaining the Genesis leaf material.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_asp
lexicon.label: asp_serpent

senses.definition: The venomous snake called asp or aspic in the supplied play. Native inherited creature category, without identification as an exact modern species or a medical assertion about its bite.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of fat
lexicon.label: grease_fat

senses.definition: Greasy fatty matter on the imagined workmen’s aprons. Material sense of native fat; does not invent its cooking or industrial source.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of countryman
lexicon.label: countryman_rustic

senses.definition: The rustic bringer of figs and the basket, the Countryman speaker in the supplied text. Not merely a compatriot or a named individual.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of food
lexicon.label: dish_food

senses.definition: Prepared food or a dish to be eaten, the countryman’s woman-as-food joke. Reuses the native food noun, not a newly specified plate shape.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of slime_river_mud
lexicon.label: slime_residue

senses.definition: A moist viscous residue the guard attributes to the asp on fig leaves and cave surfaces. Extended from native wet mud; the attribution remains a character’s observation, not zoological certification.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation: wander + star
lexicon.label: planet_wandering_star

senses.definition: A wandering celestial body in the source’s astrological classification, which includes the moon. Native wandering-star, not a modern scientific recategorization.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_yesterday
lexicon.label: yesterday_day

senses.definition: The day immediately before today in the countryman’s remembered report; no inherited Biblical event is imported.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of warm
lexicon.label: warmth_living

senses.definition: Living bodily warmth at Cleopatra’s lips in her farewell. Nominal use of native warm, not high heat or a new fever.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense/identity of kjv_infant
lexicon.label: baby_infant

senses.definition: An infant at a nursing breast, Cleopatra’s metaphor for the asp. The metaphor does not add an actual child to the stage.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_hire
lexicon.label: hire_service

senses.definition: Engage a rider or other worker by payment; native service-pay, without the inherited earlier transaction or participants.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_tradition
lexicon.label: tradition_custom

senses.definition: A handed-down social practice in the brothers’ inheritance argument; not automatically a religious command or a condemned teaching.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_orchard
lexicon.label: orchard_garden

senses.definition: The fruit garden in Oliver’s household where Orlando answers him; no particular trees or plan are supplied.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_elder_sibling
lexicon.label: elder_age

senses.definition: Older by relative age in the brother comparison; not a council officer or an assertion of moral superiority.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_wrestling
lexicon.label: wrestling_bout

senses.definition: An encounter in wrestling, the source try a fall. It does not assert that a particular contestant has already fallen or lost.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_discretion
lexicon.label: prudent_judgment

senses.definition: Forethought in deciding how to act; Oliver invokes it while encouraging violence. The noun itself does not approve his purpose.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.
lexicon.label: robin_hood

senses.definition: The legendary English figure named in Charles’s comparison; not Robin Goodfellow or an onstage arrival.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of native_place_england
lexicon.label: england_place

senses.definition: England in the Robin Hood comparison. Reviewed promotion of the existing permitted place-name stem, with a clean printed label instead of its internal historical lookup key.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of both
lexicon.label: both_pair

senses.definition: The whole pair, keeping the existing Unta two + all formation. Human-reviewed quantitative both, without replacing it by an Arabic digit or losing its inclusive force.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_heap
lexicon.label: heap_mound

senses.definition: A gathered mound, extended by Celia to the fool’s supposed store of knowledge. No exact amount or textile nap is implied.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_pigeon
lexicon.label: pigeon_bird

senses.definition: The bird whose feeding of its young supplies Celia’s news simile. Reviewed promotion of the native bird-kind stem; distinct from a turtle dove.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: off + cut
lexicon.label: interrupt_speech

senses.definition: Cut off a train of speech or reasoning. Native off + cut forms an inflecting interruption verb, retaining the cutting image without an ambiguous particle stranded outside an agent noun.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_rib
lexicon.label: rib_body

senses.definition: A human rib injured in wrestling. Reviewed anatomical side-bone sense, without importing the earlier Biblical removal or creation event.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: choose + heir
lexicon.label: adopt_heir

senses.definition: Receive a person into the family as an heir by choice rather than birth. Native choose + heir made verbal; Orlando rejects this hypothetical relation to Frederick.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: rest + day
lexicon.label: holiday_rest

senses.definition: A festive day free from ordinary labour in Celia’s flirtation joke; native rest + day, not a specific religious feast or fixed weekly date.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_adversity
lexicon.label: adversity_condition

senses.definition: Adverse circumstances in the Duke’s claimed sweet uses of adversity; native adverse-time, without importing the former Psalm speaker or a new calendar period.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: teach + speech
lexicon.label: sermon_teaching

senses.definition: An instructive moral or religious address, figuratively found in stones by the Duke; native teach + speech, with no literal new preacher in the forest.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of hip
lexicon.label: haunch_animal

senses.definition: The fleshy upper hindquarter of the deer, a contextual extension of hip; not merely an isolated pelvic bone or a human thigh.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: native_male + deer
lexicon.label: stag_deer

senses.definition: The male deer wounded in the hunter’s aim and watched by Jaques. Native male + deer, without adding species, age or antler count.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_wages
lexicon.label: service_wages

senses.definition: Payment earned through work or service, Adam’s savings from serving Orlando’s father. Distinct from hiring a worker as a verb or a gift; no additional monetary amount is implied.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_prune
lexicon.label: prune_growth

senses.definition: Cut back cultivated growth to encourage it, applied by Orlando to himself as a rotten tree. Keeps the native branch-cut verb without importing the earlier vineyard or calendar law.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_husbandry_corinthians
lexicon.label: husbandry_cultivation

senses.definition: Cultivating and caring for plant growth, Orlando’s image for Adam’s support. The native field-work compound does not imply marriage or a new plot of land.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_hosen
lexicon.label: hose_garment

senses.definition: Leg clothing worn with the doublet, contrasted with the petticoat. Not a liquid-carrying pipe, and no modern cut or fabric is specified.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: cross + mark
lexicon.label: cross_mark

senses.definition: An intersecting cross-shaped mark or object, invoked through the stamp on source-culture coins in Touchstone’s joke. Native cross + mark retains the shape; its monetary implication follows the purse clause. Not a new native religious doctrine.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of milk
lexicon.label: milk_draw

senses.definition: Draw milk from an animal. Reviewed verbal conversion of the native milk noun; no processing method or measure is added.

citations.locator: Authored native compound: round + seed + cover

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: round + seed + cover
lexicon.label: pea_pod_native

senses.definition: The pea-pod used as a surrogate beloved in Touchstone’s story. Native round + seed + cover is a lexicalized plant category, not all round-seed coverings. The odd taking of two pods from this personification is retained rather than silently corrected into peas or an added plant.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: seed + cover
lexicon.label: pod_shell

senses.definition: A seed-bearing plant pod or its enclosing shell, source cods. Native seed + cover; the source count is two pods, not two individual peas.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: leg + bone
lexicon.label: shin_body

senses.definition: The front bony part of the lower leg struck in Touchstone’s wit metaphor. Native leg + bone lexicalization names this region without asserting that every leg bone is a shin.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: small + house
lexicon.label: cottage_house

senses.definition: The small rural dwelling offered with pasture and flock. Native small + house; no implied new room count, freehold law or modern building plan.

citations.locator: Authored native compound: sheep + hair + cut

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: sheep + hair + cut
lexicon.label: shear_fleece

senses.definition: Remove wool from the sheep by cutting. Native wool + cut avoids the old unsupported source-like shirël; the source contrasts tending the flock with taking its yield, without specifying a tool design.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: breath + chamber
lexicon.label: lung_organ

senses.definition: The breathing organ, Jaques’s lungs in his crowing-laughter image. Native breath + chamber. A lexicalized anatomical term, not every chamber containing air; no new physiological theory is asserted.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_cardinal_bb_over_b

senses.definition: Exact cardinal quantity 11; Unta B.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: cut + look
lexicon.label: dissect_examine

senses.definition: Cut open for examination; figuratively expose the wise man’s folly in Jaques’s speech. Native cut + look. No actual surgery or corpse is introduced.

citations.locator: Authored native compound: lust + liberty + person

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: lust + liberty + person
lexicon.label: libertine_person

senses.definition: A person given to unrestrained sensual living in the Duke’s accusation. Native lust + liberty + person, not the historical named synagogue group or a modern political affiliation.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: adorn + garment
lexicon.label: finery_clothing

senses.definition: Showy clothing or personal display, source bravery; native adorn + garment. Distinct from courage, and no unstated specific item or price.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: faith + house
lexicon.label: church_building_native

senses.definition: The source community’s Christian worship building. Native faith + house replaces unsupported chiren in this new translation. The context specifies the institution; this does not merge every native faith-house into that historical religion.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of courtesy
lexicon.label: civility_manners

senses.definition: Socially cultivated courtesy and good manners, contrasted with Orlando’s desperate threats. No requirement of aristocratic birth or modern citizenship is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: female + deer
lexicon.label: doe_deer

senses.definition: Female deer in Orlando’s comparison of himself seeking food for Adam. Native female + deer; not a claim that Orlando or Adam is literally an animal.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: play + house
lexicon.label: theatre_space

senses.definition: A place of dramatic performance, native play + house; the universal theater is a metaphor for the world, not an asserted building surrounding it.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of part
lexicon.label: acting_role

senses.definition: A role performed by an actor, a contextual part of a dramatic performance; neither a numerical fraction nor a body part.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of complain
lexicon.label: whine_complain

senses.definition: Complain in a plaintive tone, the reluctant schoolboy’s action. Contextual extension of native voiced complaint.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: brow + hair
lexicon.label: eyebrow_hair

senses.definition: Hair of the brow above the eye, the object of the lover’s extravagant ballad; distinct from the whole forehead.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of proper
lexicon.label: formal_orderly

senses.definition: Regularly arranged according to convention, here the magistrate’s beard cut. Does not denote a formal proof or official legal enactment.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: soft + shoe
lexicon.label: slipper_shoe

senses.definition: Soft easily worn footwear, native soft + shoe, worn by the stage old man. No material or indoor location is added.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: sight + glass
lexicon.label: spectacles_sight

senses.definition: Eyeglasses aiding sight, native sight + glass as a lexicalized implement. One noun denotes the apparatus; no unsupported extra numerical count of lenses is inserted.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_ordinal_g_over_b

senses.definition: Exact ordinal quantity 6; Unta 6.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of feign
lexicon.label: feigning_noun

senses.definition: Pretence as an activity or condition, nominal use of native feign. In the song, friendship is said to be pretence, not an agent that pretends on somebody’s behalf.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: cause + know
lexicon.label: philosophy_inquiry

senses.definition: Inquiry or wisdom concerning causes and life, native cause + know. Touchstone’s broad question admits Corin’s practical maxims; no modern academic department is imposed.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: female + sheep
lexicon.label: ewe_sheep

senses.definition: Adult female sheep, native female + sheep, distinct from the male ram and young lamb.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: native_male + sheep
lexicon.label: ram_sheep

senses.definition: Adult uncastrated male sheep, native male + sheep. Animal category, not a siege weapon or a newly invented proper name.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: cut + sheep
lexicon.label: wether_sheep

senses.definition: Castrated male sheep, native cut + sheep as a lexicalized livestock category. Bell-wether here has a bell and leads sheep; retain Touchstone’s deliberately incongruous bawdy personification, not a biologically corrected ram.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of pitch
lexicon.label: tar_pitch

senses.definition: Dark sticky tar used in the source sheep-care practice. Native pitch-family material noun extended to this named substance; no claim that every pitch or resin has identical composition, and no treatment recipe supplied.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: herd + beast
lexicon.label: herd_livestock

senses.definition: Herded domestic animals, native herd + beast. Source cattle here includes the sheep just named, not exclusively cows.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of wagon
lexicon.label: cart_vehicle

senses.definition: A wheeled carrier of loads, the harvest-cart image in Touchstone’s bawdy verse. Contextual native wagon; no exact wheel count or public punishment is silently added.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: horse + run
lexicon.label: gallop_gait

senses.definition: A horse’s rapid running gait, native horse + run, figuratively applied to verse rhythm. False gallop preserves the rough or affected progression; no fixed native metrical pattern is claimed.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_span
lexicon.label: span_hand_measure

senses.definition: A hand-span, the source bodily length image enclosing an entire lifetime. Same native hand + measure as the historical witness, reviewed for later use without importing a fixed metric length.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_baggage
lexicon.label: baggage_goods

senses.definition: Carried possessions accompanying departure, native carry-goods promoted from the historical witness. In the stock military leave-taking phrase, not a wheeled carriage or the insult for a person.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_scrip
lexicon.label: scrip_pouch

senses.definition: A pouch carrying small provisions, native carry-bag promoted from the historical witness. Not script, written language or a form of money.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_palm_tree
lexicon.label: palm_tree_native

senses.definition: A palm tree, source place where Rosalind found the poem. The native historical tree term is promoted with its tree meaning; no specific species or forest relocation is invented.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: face + colour
lexicon.label: complexion_colour

senses.definition: Colour or visible appearance of the face, native face + colour. Good my complexion retains the source apostrophe and its interpretive uncertainty; do not emend it to Hudson’s complicator.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_bottle
lexicon.label: bottle_liquid

senses.definition: A portable container for liquid, promoted with the same native liquid-bag form. Source bottle is not assigned a material or volume absent from the passage.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: wood + close
lexicon.label: cork_stop

senses.definition: A cork closure for a bottle, native wood + close as a lexicalized stopper name. Its bark-derived material is part of the category; the compound does not assert it is cut solid timber or provide manufacturing instructions.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.
lexicon.label: ireland_place

senses.definition: Ireland as the rat’s source affiliation in Rosalind’s allusion. Permitted place-name adaptation, not an ordinary borrowed adjective.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.
lexicon.label: south_sea_place

senses.definition: The South Sea in Rosalind’s oceanic discovery metaphor, commonly the Pacific. Native historical south plus sea forms the geographical name; not a travel instruction or a newly invented sea.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of weight
lexicon.label: matter_importance

senses.definition: Significance or consequence in that is no matter. Figurative native weight, distinct from material substance or a specific measurable mass.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_stammer
lexicon.label: stammer_speech

senses.definition: Falter or repeat in speaking, the narrow-mouthed-bottle image of Rosalind’s impatient request. Reviewed promotion of the native speech-stumble formation. Not a medical diagnosis, an insult added by the translator, or permission to delete source repetition.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of burden
lexicon.label: burden_refrain

senses.definition: A repeated sung response or refrain, the song’s borne burden. A later literary extension of native burden that preserves Celia’s song/load image. Distinct from the unsupported ordinary loan koren; it does not imply an actual heavy object or a fixed count of repetitions.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of gallop_gait
lexicon.label: gallop_motion

senses.definition: Move at the horse’s rapid running gait; verbal use of the existing horse-run gait noun. Time gallops for the condemned thief in the source comparison, even if he walks softly.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_gallows
lexicon.label: execution_gallows

senses.definition: The hanging execution structure approached by the thief. Reviewed native hang-wood category; no new dimensions or claim about the stranger’s guilt is added.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_fringe
lexicon.label: fringe_clothing

senses.definition: Threads or trimming at a garment edge. Promoted native garment-fringe form for the forest-edge/petticoat simile, without importing the earlier historical verse’s ritual instruction.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: praise + song
lexicon.label: ode_lyric

senses.definition: A lyric poem of praise, native praise + song. The tree-hung odes exalt Rosalind; no unstated ancient metrical pattern is claimed.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: sorrow + song
lexicon.label: elegy_lament

senses.definition: A plaintive lyric or lament, native sorrow + song. Orlando’s love elegies need not announce a death; no funeral event is invented.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_bonnet
lexicon.label: cap_bonnet

senses.definition: A head covering or cap in the lover’s disordered attire. Promoted native head-cloth without the historical priestly context or a modern gendered bonnet shape.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: round + bind
lexicon.label: garment_button

senses.definition: A button fastening a garment, native round + bind as a lexicalized clothing fastener. Does not require a round geometric shape for every token or import a digital UI button.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_spit
lexicon.label: spit_saliva

senses.definition: Expel saliva from the mouth, the scornful gesture in Rosalind’s claimed treatment. Reviewed native mouth-expel form; no speech or vomiting substituted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: metal + money
lexicon.label: coin_currency

senses.definition: An individual metal monetary token, native metal + money. Distinguishes a coin from an unbounded sum; its denomination is specified separately, including the source half-penny coins.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_goat
lexicon.label: goat_native

senses.definition: The goat herded by Audrey, reviewed native animal-category form. No ritual scapegoat role or unprinted sex is added.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of shape
lexicon.label: feature_form

senses.definition: Form or fashioned appearance in Touchstone’s feature/features exchange. The native form noun leaves bodily appearance and a fashioned literary piece available; the disputed poem reading is not silently imposed as certain.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of verse
lexicon.label: poetry_art

senses.definition: Poetry as an art or generic composition, a collective non-count sense of native verse. No exact count of lines or specific classical metre is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: straw + roof
lexicon.label: thatch_roof

senses.definition: Roofing of dry stalks, native straw + roof. The poor house in the Jove allusion; no additional host names or construction method is inserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: reed + sweet
lexicon.label: sugar_native

senses.definition: Sugar, native reed + sweet as a lexicalized sweetener category, contrasted with honey. Not a loan and not a claim that every sweet reed produces the same commodity.

citations.locator: Authored native compound: small + faith + house

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: small + faith + house
lexicon.label: chapel_worship

senses.definition: A local or smaller place of worship, native small + faith-house. Kept distinct from the forest and from the church to which Jaques directs the couple; no new physical building is added onstage.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.
lexicon.label: goth_people

senses.definition: A member of the named Goth people in Touchstone’s comparison, with ordinary native plural morphology. Source name retained; not silently changed to Getae or confused with Audrey’s goats.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of company
lexicon.label: assembly_company

senses.definition: The assembled company at a wedding, contrasted with horned beasts; no formal council or parliament is added.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of fine
lexicon.label: brave_showy

senses.definition: Fine, splendid or showy, with ironic force in Celia’s repeated brave/bravely. Distinct from the narrower courageous sense; the same native stem is repeated throughout the boast parody.

citations.locator: Authored native compound: horse + spear + fight

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: horse + spear + fight
lexicon.label: joust_tilt

senses.definition: Fight with a mounted lance in the source jousting comparison, native horse + spear + fight. Not tipping an object or adding a new combat scene.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of cup
lexicon.label: goblet_cup

senses.definition: A drinking cup in the hollow-vessel simile. The source cover is separately expressed; no ornate material, shape or ritual use is added.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.
lexicon.label: diana_goddess_full

senses.definition: Full Diana form for the classical goddess in Celia’s chastity joke, corresponding to existing Dian. Not the human Diana in All’s Well; no Bible reference suffix prints.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of spur
lexicon.label: spur_horse

senses.definition: Urge a horse with the rider’s spur. Reviewed noun-to-action conversion, preserving the source one-sided riding error without an unstated race or military charge.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: milk + top
lexicon.label: cream_milk

senses.definition: The rich upper part of milk, native milk + top, in the pale-cheek image. No cosmetic preparation or modern manufacturing process.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_grain_ear
lexicon.label: grain_ear

senses.definition: A cereal seed-head, native grain-head, here broken remnants after harvesting; not an anatomical ear or specifically maize.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_axe
lexicon.label: axe_tool

senses.definition: The axe used by the executioner in Silvius’s comparison. Reviewed extension of native wood-cut tool to the same weapon/tool category, without adding a type of blade.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_south
lexicon.label: south_direction

senses.definition: The cardinal south, including the misty south wind in Rosalind’s simile. Not a particular modern country or the named South Sea.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of ease
lexicon.label: relief_ease

senses.definition: Ease from sorrow or distress, the relief Silvius asks should follow pity; not food or a relief sculpture.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of red
lexicon.label: redness_colour

senses.definition: The red coloration of a lip, nominal colour use of native red; no added blood or injury.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_drunkard
lexicon.label: drunkard_person

senses.definition: A habitually drunken person in the comparison with excessive melancholy or laughter. Reviewed native drunk-person, without importing the historical accusation context.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: music + person
lexicon.label: musician_person

senses.definition: A person practising music, native music + person, in Jaques’s list of kinds of melancholy.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_nativity
lexicon.label: birthplace_origin

senses.definition: Place or country of birth, the origin a fashionable traveller disowns in Rosalind’s caricature. Reviewed native birth-place, not the Christian festival.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: hand + beat
lexicon.label: clap_touch

senses.definition: Strike or pat with the hand, native hand + beat, here Cupid’s touch upon the shoulder. Not applause or the arrow striking the heart.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of look
lexicon.label: leer_countenance

senses.definition: A look or cast of countenance, source better leer. Nominal native look; not necessarily a lascivious expression or a taunt about poor eyesight.

citations.locator: Authored source-calendar label: Unta spoken ordinal plus day; not a native-calendar equivalence.

lexicon.etymology: Authored source-calendar label: Unta spoken ordinal plus day; not a native-calendar equivalence.
lexicon.label: friday_source

senses.definition: Friday in the source English seven-day week. Authored native calendar label using Unta word ordinal six + day, with Sunday explicitly the first day of this source-calendar convention. Not the sixth day of an invented Vayrshemon calendar or six Fridays; no foreign weekday sound is borrowed.

citations.locator: Authored source-calendar label: Unta spoken ordinal plus day; not a native-calendar equivalence.

lexicon.etymology: Authored source-calendar label: Unta spoken ordinal plus day; not a native-calendar equivalence.
lexicon.label: saturday_source

senses.definition: Saturday in the source English seven-day week. Authored native calendar label using Unta word ordinal seven + day, with Sunday explicitly first in this source-calendar convention. Not a claim about an attested native calendar or a forced substitution of the religious Sabbath observance.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_cardinal_gaaa_over_b

senses.definition: Exact cardinal quantity 6000; Unta 3580.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: speech + bird
lexicon.label: parrot_native

senses.definition: The parrot whose noisy cries are compared with a wife’s clamour before rain; native speech + bird as a lexicalized animal category, not every calling bird.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: bone + tooth
lexicon.label: hyena_native

senses.definition: The hyena invoked for its laugh-like cry, native bone + tooth as a lexicalized animal category. The comparison stays a character’s image; no particular modern species or hybrid with a dog is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: key + hole
lexicon.label: keyhole_opening

senses.definition: The opening for a key, native key + hole, in the escaping-wit image. No modern lock mechanism is specified.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_chimney
lexicon.label: chimney_smoke

senses.definition: The smoke passage from a house, native smoke-way, reused for wit escaping with smoke. Not a window or a newly added fire onstage.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of nurture_upbringing
lexicon.label: nurture_rear

senses.definition: Bring up or form a child through care and training, source breed it like a fool. Explicit verbal extension of native upbringing; not beget a new child.

citations.locator: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic adaptation of a personal name.
lexicon.label: portugal_place

senses.definition: Portugal in the Bay of Portugal comparison. Preserve the geographical label without replacing it with a guessed modern bay or a measured depth.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_bow
lexicon.label: bow_weapon

senses.definition: The stringed weapon used with arrows in Celia’s remark about Orlando. Reviewed native curved-string bow; not the bodily action of bowing or the rainbow extension.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_errand
lexicon.label: errand_task

senses.definition: A task on which someone is sent, here Silvius carrying Phoebe’s letter. Native send-work; not the contents of the message or an assertion that he knows them.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_defy
lexicon.label: hostile_defy

senses.definition: Openly challenge in hostility. Native challenge-against, promoted for Rosalind’s rhetorical description of Phoebe’s letter; distinct from its actually affectionate wording.

citations.locator: Authored native compound: soft + green + cover

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: soft + green + cover
lexicon.label: moss_growth

senses.definition: Moss growing over the old oak’s branches. Native soft-green-cover as a lexicalized plant category; not any green cloth or all plants.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_rag
lexicon.label: ragged_clothing

senses.definition: Wearing torn or worn clothing, the ragged sleeping man. Native rag form used adjectivally; not a change to his identity or the source’s account of how he arrived.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_bald
lexicon.label: bald_bare

senses.definition: Bare of hair or its figurative leafy counterpart on the oak’s high top. Native hairless expression; the tree metaphor is preserved without diagnosing disease.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: milk + breast
lexicon.label: udder_animal

senses.definition: The milk-bearing breast of an animal, here the lioness’s drawn-dry udders. Native milk-breast; the source plural is retained without supplying an anatomical count.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native compound: mouth + crush
lexicon.label: chew_food

senses.definition: Work food with the mouth, native mouth-crush, used metaphorically for Orlando considering sweet and bitter fancy. Not an assertion that he was actually eating.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of political_faction
lexicon.label: faction_party

senses.definition: A partisan group brought into a quarrel, the threatened bandying in faction. Native divided-party sense; no modern political institution or new group appearing onstage.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_heathen
lexicon.label: heathen_source

senses.definition: Outside the speaker’s Christian religious tradition, as Touchstone labels the unnamed philosopher. Native outside-people expression reviewed for this new source; not an imported Israel-versus-neighbours reference or the translator’s disparagement.

citations.locator: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked

lexicon.etymology: Origins_3_Unta_2 chart and explicit quantitative construction; Chart-2 cardinal; productive ordinal/multiple morphology where marked
lexicon.label: unta_cardinal_cf_over_b

senses.definition: Exact cardinal quantity 25; Unta 21.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_magician
lexicon.label: magician_practitioner

senses.definition: A practitioner of purported magical arts in Rosalind’s claimed acquaintance and self-description. Reviewed native specialist name, without the historical court context, asserted real efficacy or automatic condemnation.

lexicon.etymology: Reviewed contextual sense of kjv_stair
lexicon.label: stair_step

senses.definition: A step in a flight of stairs, native up-step, extended to successive courtship stages. Source pair of stairs denotes a flight, not two staircases or a supplied exact tread count.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: winter + corn
lexicon.label: rye_grain

senses.definition: Rye as the cereal in the lovers’ field. Authored winter-grain lexical category, not an assertion that all winter grain is rye.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: field + part
lexicon.label: acre_plot

senses.definition: A field strip or cultivated plot in the song. No exact acreage is stated; not a forced modern area conversion.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: wander + people
lexicon.label: romani_source_people

senses.definition: The people called gypsies in the source comparison. Authored native ethnonym wander-people for this source-cultural referent, not a claim that all Romani travel or that every traveller is Romani. Source ethnonym and its outsider stereotype remain documented.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: illness
lexicon.label: disease_ailment

senses.definition: An ailment in the source deliberately odd dulcet diseases phrase; do not silently emend to phrases.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: food + wood
lexicon.label: dining_board

senses.definition: A dining board, hence shared sustenance in board and bed; not a writing tablet.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: brother + daughter
lexicon.label: niece_kin

senses.definition: A brother’s daughter, here Duke Senior’s niece Celia; not his literal daughter or a claim that sister’s daughters are excluded from the broader kinship category.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: friend
lexicon.label: ally_person

senses.definition: A person or relation allied through shared interests, including the marriage connections promised to Oliver; not a claim of an actual military treaty.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: heap_mound
lexicon.label: heap_pile

senses.definition: Gather into a heap, used figuratively of overflowing joy at the final dance.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: food + give
lexicon.label: supply_food

senses.definition: Provision with food for a journey, Jaques’s metaphor for a short-lived marriage.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: long + spear
lexicon.label: pike_weapon

senses.definition: The long thrusting spear of the protestors, not the fish.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: suffer
lexicon.label: suffering_condition

senses.definition: The experience of deprivation and harm, nominal use of native suffer; not permission to act.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: covet
lexicon.label: covetous_greedy

senses.definition: Greedily wanting wealth, the specific accusation the second citizen rejects in Martius’s case.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_storehouse
lexicon.label: storehouse_building

senses.definition: A building storing supplies, the citizens’ accusation that stored grain is withheld. Reviewed promotion of the native historical category, not a modernization of any Bible file.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_flour
lexicon.label: flour_food

senses.definition: Ground grain, here the best nourishing portion in Menenius’s flour-versus-bran fable; not the flower.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: law + undo
lexicon.label: repeal_law

senses.definition: Remove a law’s force, the citizen’s charge that laws restraining the rich are repealed.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: store
lexicon.label: cupboard_store

senses.definition: Put away food in storage, the accusation against the fable’s belly; not a new architectural room.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: carry + away
lexicon.label: carry_away

senses.definition: Carry someone away, physically or figuratively; calamity is the carrier in the opening political argument, not supernatural magic.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: law
lexicon.label: statute_public

senses.definition: A prescribed public law in the citizens’ accusation about class oppression; distinct from a debt security.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: plan
lexicon.label: devise_plan

senses.definition: Think out or contrive an action, the planning function among the body’s faculties.
