lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: watch
lexicon.label: vigilant_watchful

senses.definition: Watchfully alert, the eye as a guard in the bodily polity.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: foot + finger
lexicon.label: toe_body

senses.definition: A digit of the foot, source great toe in the body-politics insult; native foot-finger, not a numeral or a finger on a hand.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: wound + skin
lexicon.label: scab_skin

senses.definition: The crust or damaged skin of a sore, with the contemptible-person insult retained through the body metaphor. Native wound-skin category, not a foreign insult loan.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: common_people + guard
lexicon.label: tribune_plebs

senses.definition: The office of protector/representative of the ordinary people granted in the play. Native common-people-guard; distinct from a military commander or a modern newspaper.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: piece
lexicon.label: fragment_scrap

senses.definition: A fragment or scrap, including Martius’s dehumanizing address to citizens and the proverbs he calls shreds.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: damp + old
lexicon.label: musty_stale

senses.definition: Stale or mould-smelling after storage, Martius’s metaphor for the population surplus he expects war to expend. Not a literal medical diagnosis.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: hard
lexicon.label: stiff_body

senses.definition: Bodily stiffness or difficulty moving, the teasing question to Lartius; not necessarily obstinacy or a specified medical diagnosis.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: walk + support
lexicon.label: crutch_aid

senses.definition: A support used by someone with impaired walking, Lartius’s proposed support and improvised weapon; no medical cause added.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: bite
lexicon.label: gnaw_bite

senses.definition: Bite repeatedly or steadily at something, the rats-and-grainstores taunt; a contextual gnawing sense of native bite.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: pride
lexicon.label: insolence_pride

senses.definition: Arrogant disregard for others, the tribunes’ accusation about Martius’s willingness to take orders; not the narrator’s endorsement.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: compel + gather
lexicon.label: enlist_force

senses.definition: Gather or levy people into armed service, the letter’s pressed a power. Not a printing press, financial tribute or a claim of voluntary enlistment.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: gold
lexicon.label: golden_colour

senses.definition: Gold-coloured or shining like gold, the gilded butterfly. No literal metal coating or alchemical transformation is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: fine_linen
lexicon.label: cambric_cloth

senses.definition: The fine linen fabric being sewn, source cambric. Native fine-linen category rather than borrowing the ordinary cloth word from its foreign place-name origin.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: thread + make
lexicon.label: spin_yarn

senses.definition: Make thread by spinning fibres, Penelope’s yarn, distinct from turning the body in a circle.

citations.locator: Authored source-calendar label: Unta spoken ordinal plus day; not a native-calendar equivalence.

lexicon.etymology: Authored source-calendar label: Unta spoken ordinal plus day; not a native-calendar equivalence.
lexicon.label: wednesday_source

senses.definition: Wednesday in the source English seven-day week, named with native Unta spoken ordinal four plus day under the already documented Sunday-first source-calendar convention. Not a claim about an attested Vayrshemon calendar or four Wednesdays.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_ladder
lexicon.label: ladder_climbing

senses.definition: A runged or stepped means of climbing, here against a fortified city. Reviewed native historical category; no unprinted material or ladder count.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_pot
lexicon.label: cooking_pot

senses.definition: A cooking vessel in the soldiers’ to-the-pot destruction idiom; native pot category, not an assertion that Martius is literally cooked.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: contagious
lexicon.label: contagion_disease

senses.definition: Communicable affliction in Martius’s south-wind curse, nominal use of native illness-spread. No modern pathogen or actual outbreak is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_spoon
lexicon.label: spoon_utensil

senses.definition: The eating/serving utensil in Martius’s contemptuous inventory, here made of lead. Reviewed historical native category without a liturgical function.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_greyhound
lexicon.label: greyhound_hound

senses.definition: A swift coursing dog in the source submissive-hound simile, not a modern registered breed specification. Reviewed native swift-dog category.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: dog + bind
lexicon.label: leash_restraint

senses.definition: A restraint on a dog that can be released, native dog-bind; applied figuratively to the captive city without inventing the material or mechanism.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: time + space
lexicon.label: interval_gap

senses.definition: A gap between ongoing events, the times at which distant fighting can be heard. No fixed duration is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_sacrifice
lexicon.label: sacrifice_offering

senses.definition: A sacrificial offering to the Roman gods in Cominius’s petition, using the native cut-gift category; no victim species, number or theological endorsement is added.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: front + army
lexicon.label: vanguard_army

senses.definition: The forward formation of an army, source vaward; not a naval guard or an unstated numerical formation.

citations.locator: Authored native derivation/sense: before + look + person

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: before + look + person
lexicon.label: scout_observer

senses.definition: A military observer and guide, the scout conducting Lartius toward the Roman camp. No report or enemy allegiance invented.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: ancestor + kin
lexicon.label: lineage_race

senses.definition: Ancestral stock or lineage in Aufidius’s Hector challenge, source progeny; not specifically Martius’s future children or a modern biological race taxonomy.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: whip
lexicon.label: whip_scourge

senses.definition: A scourge as an instrument of punishment, figuratively Hector as the formidable warrior of Rome’s claimed Trojan stock; no change of the local ancestry claim.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic personal-name adaptation
lexicon.label: africa_region

senses.definition: The geographic Africa of Aufidius’s serpent comparison, source Afric; no modern border or single nationality is imposed.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: horse + cloth
lexicon.label: caparison_trappings

senses.definition: A horse’s covering and trappings, Lartius’s subordinate role in the horse metaphor; no modern saddle design is added.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: wound + rot
lexicon.label: fester_wound

senses.definition: A wound becoming corrupt, in Cominius’s personification of wounds resenting ingratitude; no present diagnosis is supplied.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: hand + fetter
lexicon.label: manacle_hand

senses.definition: A restraint for the hands in Cominius’s comparison with someone intent on self-harm; proposed figurative restraint, not an enacted imprisonment.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: sacred + refuge
lexicon.label: sanctuary_refuge

senses.definition: Sacred refuge protecting a person from attack, one restraint Aufidius threatens to violate. No particular law code or successful refuge claim is invented.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_cypress
lexicon.label: cypress_tree

senses.definition: The source cypress trees of the rendezvous grove; reviewed native source-category term, not an ordinary foreign-sound loan or modern botanical identification.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_mill
lexicon.label: mill_grinding

senses.definition: A grain-grinding mill near the city, without inventing water, wind or animal power for the unspecified mills.

lexicon.etymology: Author-permitted phonetic personal-name adaptation
lexicon.label: jupiter_roman

senses.definition: The Roman god invoked by name when Coriolanus forgets his former host; source Jupiter, the same divine referent as Jove but preserving this source name form.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: free
lexicon.label: freedom_state

senses.definition: The state of being free, requested for the captive former host. Explicit nominal use of native free; no assertion that the release has happened yet.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: neck + body_back
lexicon.label: nape_neck

senses.definition: The back of the neck in Menenius’s impossible backward-looking self-survey. No injury or medical claim is implied.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_magistrate
lexicon.label: magistrate_official

senses.definition: A civic official with judicial authority, the tribunes whom Menenius mocks; reviewed native judge-rule category, not a modern office imported wholesale.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: spark + food
lexicon.label: tinder_ignition

senses.definition: Readily ignitable material, native spark-food, for Menenius’s quick temper; no material recipe or literal fire-setting is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: orange + fruit
lexicon.label: orange_fruit

senses.definition: The citrus fruit sold by the orange-wife, lexicalized native colour-fruit category. Distinct from the orange colour adjective and not every orange-coloured fruit.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: war + journey
lexicon.label: campaign_military

senses.definition: A military expedition; the latest campaign contrasted with earlier wounds. Not an electoral canvass or an invented additional war.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: merit + acquire
lexicon.label: merit_earn

senses.definition: Acquire through deserving action, Menenius’s true purchasing of praise; no payment of money is implied.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_coffin
lexicon.label: coffin_container

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_nettle
lexicon.label: nettle_plant

senses.definition: The stinging plant in Menenius’s plain-naming proverb. Retains the native thorn-leaf category without identifying a modern species or borrowing its English name.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: cook + house
lexicon.label: kitchen_room

senses.definition: The domestic place of cooking; the kitchen servant in Brutus’s description, not a new independent dwelling.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: face + colour
lexicon.label: complexion_face

senses.definition: The various facial appearances or colours of the spectators, without converting the source phrase into modern ethnic categories.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: noise + stir
lexicon.label: pother_commotion

senses.definition: Excited bustle and fuss surrounding the return, not a new insurrection or an actual battle.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_camel
lexicon.label: camel_beast

senses.definition: The source burden-bearing animal in the tribunes’ military analogy, retaining the reviewed native category without choosing a camel species or modernizing the historical Bible.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: small + nail
lexicon.label: pin_fastener

senses.definition: A small pointed fastener securing the kitchen servant’s linen at her neck. Native small-nail category, distinct from the action pinch or a nail-counting expression.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: body + hold
lexicon.label: posture_bearing

senses.definition: The carriage or bearing of the body, here the graceful posture Brutus imagines as divinely bestowed. Not a fighting stance or the birth verb bear.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: rise
lexicon.label: ascent_rank

senses.definition: An advance in public standing, the second officer’s account of Coriolanus’s earned rise. Explicit nominal rise, not a literal mountain climb.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: speak + matter
lexicon.label: topic_matter

senses.definition: The subject under discussion, including a person as theme of a meeting; lexicalized native speech-material, not physical matter.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: monster + make
lexicon.label: monster_exaggerate

senses.definition: Enlarge small deeds into prodigious things in praise, Coriolanus’s my nothings monstered. Native monster-make preserves the image; no literal creatures appear.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: high + fly
lexicon.label: soar_high

senses.definition: Fly or rise high, figuratively the insolence that towers over the people. Native high-fly retains the upward image without asserting actual flight.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: dark + cause
lexicon.label: darken_obscure

senses.definition: Make dark or obscure, the paradoxical effect of the people’s blaze upon Coriolanus’s reputation. Not physical blindness or a new eclipse.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: fire + light
lexicon.label: blaze_flame

senses.definition: A bright burning flame, figuratively the people’s anger in the stubble image; no new literal conflagration is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: ship + front
lexicon.label: ship_prow

senses.definition: The forward part of a vessel, source stem in the ship-and-weeds simile; not a plant stalk or grammatical stem.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: head + bone
lexicon.label: skull_bone

senses.definition: The bony enclosure of the head, imagined as a single container for all the citizens’ divergent wits; no actual anatomical experiment is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: direction + circle
lexicon.label: compass_directions

senses.definition: The whole circle of directions in the citizens’ scattering-wits joke. No particular number of points or invented navigational instrument appears.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: strong + fasten
lexicon.label: wedge_fast

senses.definition: Jam or fasten tightly, the wit stuck in the blockhead. Native strong-fasten; not a geometric measurement or a specified tool.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: office + mark
lexicon.label: official_insignia

senses.definition: The marks of public office worn after selection, source official marks. Native office-mark; distinct from bodily wounds as marks of merit and without inventing particular insignia.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: hate
lexicon.label: hatred_hostility

senses.definition: Hostile feeling, explicit nominal use of native hate in the tribunes’ accusations and Aufidius’s rivalry. It is attributed to the named speaker or reported person, not adopted as narrative judgment.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: endure
lexicon.label: endurance_capacity

senses.definition: Capacity or tolerance for bearing something, source noble sufferance. Explicit nominal endure; neither a command to suffer nor a claim that the nobles must approve.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: perceive
lexicon.label: perception_awareness

senses.definition: Awareness or apprehension of current behavior, source apprehension of his portance. Explicit nominal perceive, not anxiety or physical arrest.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: hinder
lexicon.label: hindrance_obstacle

senses.definition: Something obstructing the intended action, source impediment in the account the tribunes propose. Explicit nominal hinder without inventing a particular obstruction.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: strong + say
lexicon.label: emphasize_stress

senses.definition: Stress or press a point in argument, source enforce his pride. Native strong-say rather than physical enforcement of the emotion.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_raid
lexicon.label: raid_incursion

senses.definition: Make a hostile incursion, source make road upon us. Reviewed native strike-enter; distinct from building or traveling a road.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_sedition
lexicon.label: sedition_discord

senses.definition: Political discord or incited rebellion in Coriolanus’s accusation. Reviewed native rebel-stir; the accusation belongs to the character, not the narrator.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_sow
lexicon.label: sow_seed

senses.definition: Put seed into soil for a crop, reviewed native sow in the rebellion-as-weed metaphor. Distinct from planting a grown plant and from the following scattering action; no physical planting scene is added.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: small + fish_creature
lexicon.label: minnow_smallfish

senses.definition: The little fish under the mock Triton’s rule, native small-fish category. Preserves the scale contrast without claiming a modern taxonomic species.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_navel
lexicon.label: navel_body

senses.definition: The bodily navel, reviewed native belly-mark, figuratively the state’s vital center under threat. No new anatomical injury or city location is invented.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: taste
lexicon.label: taste_flavour

senses.definition: Flavour perceived by taste, explicit nominal native taste in the blended-voices comparison. The dominant flavor of the mixture represents the commoners’ influence, not a literal meal.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_goat
lexicon.label: goat_animal

senses.definition: The animal in Coriolanus’s old-goat insult to Sicinius; reviewed native animal root, not a literal transformation or a new goat character.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: rule + officer
lexicon.label: civic_magistrate

senses.definition: A holder of civic governing authority, here the elected tribunes naming themselves the people’s magistrates. Native rule-officer; not a modern specialist court judge or a new office different from their tribunate.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_kindle_fire
lexicon.label: kindle_fire

senses.definition: Ignite or stir fire, metaphorically inflame political anger. Reviewed native fire-kindling sense; distinct from lighting a particular lamp.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: restrain + gentle
lexicon.label: temperate_restrained

senses.definition: Restrained and measured in proceeding, Menenius’s contrast with violent redress. Native restrained-gentle; not an assertion about climate or bodily temperature.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: wild + person
lexicon.label: barbarian_uncivil

senses.definition: An uncivilized outsider in Coriolanus’s hostile denial that the commoners are true Romans. Native wild-person preserves his insult; not a neutral ethnic classification or a translator assertion that the people are less human.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: measure + reckon
lexicon.label: arithmetic_reckoning

senses.definition: Numerical reckoning in the claim that the hostile odds exceed calculation. Native measure-reckon names the discipline; no unstated count or decimal system is substituted for Unta.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_viper
lexicon.label: viper_serpent

senses.definition: A venomous snake in Sicinius’s accusation against Coriolanus. Reviewed native poison-serpent; no actual transformation or modern species identification is asserted.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_pound_weight
lexicon.label: pound_weight

senses.definition: The source pound-weight in imagined leaden restraints on haste. Reviewed native weight category, not money or a verb of beating; no number of pounds or weight-standard conversion is invented.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_wool
lexicon.label: wool_material

senses.definition: The textile material in woolen vassals, retaining the class-marking clothing and sheep association without changing the people into animals.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: mouth + open
lexicon.label: yawn_mouth

senses.definition: Open the mouth in yawning, in Coriolanus’s contemptuous picture of the passive public. Native mouth-open lexicalized for this action; not an added spoken protest.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: violent + illness
lexicon.label: convulsive_fit

senses.definition: A violent attack or convulsive episode used as an image for the political crisis. Native violent-illness; not suitedness and not a diagnosis of an actual person.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: fit + make
lexicon.label: frame_adapt

senses.definition: Shape or adjust oneself or one’s disposition to the required conduct. Native fit-make; neither an editor text frame nor the fabrication of a criminal charge.

citations.locator: Authored native derivation/sense: horse + foot + ring

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: horse + foot + ring
lexicon.label: stirrup_footrest

senses.definition: A riding foot-support in which the armed knee bends. Native horse-foot-ring preserves the supplied theatrical anachronism without importing the English word or asserting a Roman archaeological date.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: against + say
lexicon.label: contradiction_opposition

senses.definition: Spoken opposition in Brutus’s description of Coriolanus having his full portion of contradiction. Native against-say; preserves the supplied worth reading rather than silently emending it to word.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_loins
lexicon.label: loins_body

senses.definition: The bodily region named as the source of offspring in Cominius’s family-value comparison. Reviewed native body term, without inventing another child beyond the source.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_marsh
lexicon.label: fen_marsh

senses.definition: Wet marshland in the rotten-fen comparison. Reviewed native wet-land; not a named place or a newly specified disease source.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: teach + rule
lexicon.label: precept_teaching

senses.definition: An instructive principle remembered from Volumnia’s upbringing of her son. Native teach-rule, not a newly enacted civic statute.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: roast + rod
lexicon.label: roasting_spit

senses.definition: A cooking rod imagined as a weapon in the widows’ revenge. Native roast-rod; distinct from expelling saliva.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: slip
lexicon.label: slippery_unstable

senses.definition: Unstable and liable to slip, figuratively the world’s reversals of friendship and enmity. Native slip as a modifier; no claim that an actual floor is wet.

lexicon.etymology: Authored native derivation/sense: kjv_hearth
lexicon.label: hearth_fire

senses.definition: The domestic fireplace or fire-floor where the stranger asks to stand. Reviewed native historical hearth; not the whole home or the host’s heart.
